summary: Confirmed both requested estimates against PDF p. 9, Table 1 and section 4.1: the arm-specific means, SDs, analyzed participant counts and pairwise Tukey p-value bounds match the paper. The null pair-specific totals and unreported contrast statistics are appropriate. PDF pp. 4-5, 8-9 and 11 support the outcome coding: with_ai, usefulness, expert_raters, participant, more_creative, outcome_with_ai true, immediate, within_person null and participant se_basis. Both ai_vs_active codes are supported by the TDL arm using printed materials and online references for design exploration (PDF p. 5, section 3.3). Read the complete 695-line markdown conversion through the final reference. No missing eligible outcome or contrast was identified in the supplied paper: all three reported design-achievement contrasts are present; the other measured outcomes are self-reports, and no separate rubric-dimension results are reported. The apparent inconsistency between the printed arm summaries and reported significance is already disclosed in the extraction and is not a transcription error. The 16-page PDF contains no appended or embedded supplement. External Supplementary Table S1, identified on PDF p. 5 as the design operation sheet, could not be independently retrieved: Frontiers and Figshare API requests both failed with WinError 10013.
